blurb: Strathcona Beer Company brews classic international style beers on site using fresh, high-quality ingredients. They operate two taprooms: Hastings Street in Vancouver with a 67 seat tasting room and gourmet pizza kitchen, and Strathcona North in North Vancouver with a waterfront view, a bottle shop, and a menu featuring beers and cocktails. Guests can enjoy tastings, food, and purchase beer to go.
extraNote: Hastings Street Taproom: 895 East Hastings Street, Vancouver, BC; Strathcona North: 123 Carrie Cates Court #108, North Vancouver, BC
